title: list_sessions — LIVE workers keyed by session (no worker_id exposed)
description: Domain: session/message (host). Sources: src/bin/ion.rs:6448 (fast path) and 7303 (write path); identical shapes. This is the running-worker view; for the disk index see list_all_sessions. No params. Wire envelope (validated separately, not by this schema): worker replies {"id","type":"response","command","success":true,"data":<this payload>} (src/worker_rpc.rs output_response); host replies {"type":"response","id","success":true,"data":<this payload>,"session"?}. Errors use {"success":false,"error":string} with no data.
